title: API config design sketch (personal draft)
content:
Personal sketch / scratchpad for API-config shape and runtime routing options. Mostly notes to self, rough JSON-shape ideas, and questions to follow up on with SRE and runtime teams.

Context:
- Goal: define a compact, extensible config shape for per-route inference options that can be used across hosted, dedicated, and private.
- Constraints: minimal surface for product users (simple defaults), full fidelity for infra (routing, quantization, fallback).

High-level thoughts:
- Split config into 3 layers: user_route_config (product-facing), infra_profile (pre-baked profiles for common workloads), runtime_overrides (internal/operator use).
- Keep model selection and fallback separate from batching/cache policies so we can roll out fallbacks without touching cost controls.

Rough schema (sketch):
{
  "route_id": "string",
  "user_config": {
    "model": "redwood/longform-v1",            // user-visible model name or alias
    "max_tokens": 1024,
    "temperature": 0.0,
    "top_p": 0.95,
    "response_mode": "stream|batch"
  },
  "serve_policy": {
    "priority": "low|standard|high",          // affects routing to capacity tiers
    "region_preference": ["us-west1", "eu-central1"],
    "fallbacks": ["redwood/longform-v1-quant", "redwood/longform-v1-ffn"]
  },
  "infra_profile": "low_latency_small_batch",   // maps to batching/quantization presets
  "batching": {
    "enabled": true,
    "max_batch_size": 64,
    "max_wait_ms": 8
  },
  "cache": {
    "kv_cache_enabled": true,
    "prefix_cache_ttl_seconds": 300
  },
  "quantization": {
    "profile": "q4_0|q8_0",
    "auto_select": true
  },
  "observability": {
    "sample_rate": 0.01,
    "log_level": "info|debug"
  }
}

Notes on specific fields:
- serve_policy.fallbacks: ordered list. runtime should try primary model, then variants. Idea: include metadata about compatibility (max_seq_len, tokenizer).
- infra_profile: internal mapping maintained in console (UI shows presets like low_latency_small_batch, cost_saver_large_batch). Profiles drive kernel selection + quantization.
- batching.max_wait_ms: important knob for latency-sensitive routes; default 8ms seems reasonable but need SLO data.

Routing idea (sketch):
- Request arrives -> authorize -> attach route config -> policy engine decides: preferred_region, target_capacity_tier -> pick model variant (exact name + quantization) -> select node pool (dedicated vs shared) -> apply batching/cache settings at runtime.

ASCII diagram:
[client] -> [api gateway] -> [policy engine] -> [router]
                                      |
                           [model variant resolver] -> [node pool]
                                      |
                           [batcher] -> [runtime worker] -> [kv-cache]

Open questions / TODOs:
- How to express "model compatibility" in the config (tokenizer, max context) without exposing internal model IDs to users? Maybe model aliases + a compatibility manifest maintained in model-catalog.
- Default profile mapping: product team wants simple dropdown (fast/cost/quality). Need mapping table and UX copy.
- RBAC: who can set infra_profile/runtime_overrides? Admins only. We need validation in Console + API.
- Validation: implement schema checks in control plane + dry-run mode (lint) to show estimated cost impact (approx token/sec).

Quick example use-cases:
1) Chat widget (low latency): user_config: {model: "chat-medium", max_tokens: 512}, serve_policy.priority=high, infra_profile=low_latency_small_batch, batching.max_wait_ms=4
2) Bulk summarization (cost-sensitive): user_config.model="longform", infra_profile=cost_saver_large_batch, batching.max_batch_size=256, cache.kv_cache_enabled=false

Implementation notes (follow-ups for infra):
- SRE: need an endpoint in control plane to validate configs against current model catalog. Link to INF-4567.
- Runtime: support for per-route batch knobs exists but need to ensure safe resource isolation when max_batch_size large. Add admission control.
- Telemetry: add cost-estimate field populated at validation time and surface in UI.

Links/refs:
- Confluence: API-CONFIG-1234 (proto of profiles)
- JIRA: INF-4567 (validation API)
- GH draft: infra PR 789 (router changes)

Notes to self before pairing with SRE/Jamie:
- Draft a small JSON schema for validation (will attach)
- Collect 3 real customer routes to test defaults (chat widget, email digest, search rerank)
- Brainstorm product UX copy with Product/Console team

End of sketch.

-- ryan
